simulator.dst: components of the opposing offense in the same world, shifted to the Sleeper mean by whole points plus a coin for the fraction
simulator.kicker: extra points off the offense's own touchdowns, field goals at a Poisson mean solved so the level lands on the projection
simulator.lattice: every score recomputes from integer components through DraftKings' own scorer -- offense, kicker and defense alike -- so all of them are reachable (research/sd_support)
simulator.marginals: component means scaled BEFORE the draw so the mean lands on Sleeper with whole yards and catches; no multiply touches a finished score
simulator.receiving_noise: none beyond the shared game, team-passing and script factors

meta.money: gate CLOSED; no payout figure is computed or cited in this stage
meta.opponent_count_contract: a submission of exactly k entries faces C - k public opponents; the grid for size k is built at C - k + 1 entries so its internal C-1 is exactly C - k, and the qualifying place counts are asserted unchanged. The 20-entry portfolio uses C - 20 throughout selection AND held-out scoring so the matrix does not shift as the greedy grows.
meta.question: does selecting for Top 0.1% beat selecting for Top 1% on HELD-OUT extreme-tail coverage, or is the in-sample gap an artifact of the leakage S4.1 found?
meta.stage: S4 portfolio objective cross-fit (RESEARCH; nothing promoted)

tie_conventions.half_mass: APPROXIMATION, reported as a centre point only. Halving the tie intensity is Poisson thinning, which conditional on T tied opponents puts Binomial(T, 1/2) ahead of us rather than the Uniform{0..T} a true random place in the block gives -- same mean, different distribution. The decision rests on the two exact endpoints. Exact fractional credit, if ever needed: E[min(1, d/(T+1))] = P(T<=d-1) + (d/mu) P(T>=d+1).
tie_conventions.optimistic: EXACT. only field mass strictly above counts (production today)
tie_conventions.pessimistic: EXACT. every tied opponent finishes ahead of us
